newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan does not need urgent new economic moves--EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan does not need urgent new economic moves--EPA.

text.p: Japan does not need urgent new measures to help the economy, Economic Planning Agency Minister Taro Aso told a news conference on Friday.

Aso quoted Construction Minister Shizuka Kamei as telling other cabinet ministers at Friday's regular cabinet meeting that his ministry planned to bring forward planned government spending on public works to support the economic recovery.

Asked if Kamei's view on bringing forward public works spending in the fiscal year starting on April 1 was a cabinet consensus, Aso said: "At the moment I don't think it is necessary to come up with urgent special new measures for the economy."
